source.document_reference: APQC PCF Cross-Industry v8.0 (Feb 2026), 9.3.2 Perform general accounting (10748) with reporting under 9.3.4 (10750); step decomposition per MSc provenance artefact with Trintech/HighRadius R2R/OpsDog documentation.

steps.name: Close calendar initiation and subledger cutoff
steps.description: Initiate the period-end close per the close calendar: confirm subledger cutoff (AP, AR, fixed assets, payroll), lock transaction posting, distribute the close checklist with task owners and deadlines, confirm data readiness for journal preparation.
inputs: Subledger status (AP, AR, fixed assets, payroll)

steps.name: Period-end journal entries
steps.description: Prepare and post period-end journal entries per the close checklist: recurring accruals from templates and schedules; prepayment releases per amortisation schedules; provisions and estimates requiring judgment and supporting documentation (bad debt, inventory, litigation); reclassifications and error corrections. Mix of mechanical template-driven entries and estimation-based entries requiring preparer judgment and evidence.
outputs: Period-end journals posted with supporting evidence

steps.name: Process allocations
steps.description: Run cost and overhead allocations per the allocation model: shared-service recharges, corporate overhead distribution, intercompany management fees. Validate allocation bases and post allocation journals.

steps.name: Intercompany processing
steps.description: Match and reconcile intercompany balances across entities (AR/AP mirror accounts, loans, recharges); investigate and resolve mismatches with counterparty entities; process settlements and netting; prepare elimination entries for consolidation. Matching is high-volume and rule-based; mismatch resolution requires inter-entity coordination and judgment.

steps.name: GL and balance-sheet reconciliations
steps.description: Reconcile GL accounts to subledgers, bank statements and supporting schedules per the reconciliation policy; accounts risk-rated with frequency and reviewer requirements varying by rating; prepare reconciliation certifications with supporting evidence; flag and age unreconciled items for resolution.

steps.name: Trial balance, consolidation and eliminations
steps.description: Prepare the trial balance; run consolidation across entities including currency translation, elimination of intercompany balances and profit, and minority-interest processing; validate consolidated balances against entity submissions.

steps.name: Management review and adjustments
steps.description: Review draft consolidated results against expectations and prior period; investigate anomalies; determine, document and post management adjustments; sign off account-level results for reporting.

steps.name: Financial reporting package
steps.description: Compile the period-end reporting package: financial statements, management commentary, variance schedules and KPI summaries; distribute to management and group per the reporting timetable.

requirements.statement: The GL reconciliation function must survive the redesign in some form; it may be retained, restructured, merged or absorbed, but not eliminated.
The intercompany processing function must survive in some form.
Reconciliation must be complete before the reporting package is produced.
Management review must occur before the reporting package is produced.
Journal preparation and management review must not be performed by the same actor.
The reporting package function must survive in some form.
Management review of the close must survive in some form.
